description: This source file defines functions and data structures related to port validation and management within the 'net' namespace, including lists of restricted ports, allowed ports, and functions to check port validity, restrictions, and allowability.

classes.name: ScopedPortException
classes.description: A RAII class that temporarily allows a specific port by adding it to the explicitly allowed ports list upon construction and removing it upon destruction.

classes.name: ScopedAllowablePortForTesting
classes.description: A testing utility class that sets a scoped allowable port for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsPortValid
methods.description: Checks if a port number is within the valid range (0 to 65535).

methods.name: IsWellKnownPort
methods.description: Checks if a port number is a well-known port (less than 1024).

methods.name: IsPortAllowedForScheme
methods.description: Determines if a port is allowed for a given URL scheme, considering restrictions and explicit allowances.

methods.name: GetCountOfExplicitlyAllowedPorts
methods.description: Returns the number of ports explicitly allowed.

methods.name: SetExplicitlyAllowedPorts
methods.description: Sets the list of ports that are explicitly allowed despite restrictions.

methods.name: IsAllowablePort
methods.description: Checks if a port is allowable, considering the list of allowable ports and scoped allowables.

methods.name: ScopedPortException::ScopedPortException
methods.description: Constructor that adds a port to the explicitly allowed list.

methods.name: ScopedPortException::~ScopedPortException
methods.description: Destructor that removes the port from the explicitly allowed list.

methods.name: ScopedAllowablePortForTesting::ScopedAllowablePortForTesting
methods.description: Sets a scoped allowable port for testing.

methods.name: ScopedAllowablePortForTesting::~ScopedAllowablePortForTesting
methods.description: Resets the scoped allowable port after testing.
